title: Every doc is shown by its hash id and title
quote: No: reference the hash and the title.
means: No D-n or AIP-n numbers. Every doc, decisions and intents included, gets a flat hash id in the migration and is referenced by it (d-f83e, d-eb50). Wherever a doc is shown, in the apps, in brain prime and in text, it reads as its hash id with its title, for example "aip-<hex> · brain: theOS's memory". New decisions and intents get hash ids like every other doc, and their order is their time.

supersedes.what: Not D-n and AIP-n names: every doc is shown by its hash id and its title.

reflection.checked: every decision before d-4e7c that held
